outcome: TSH level at 3rd day after birth
cohort: The study included 625 term inborn neonates (53.1% female, 46.9% male) delivered in a hospital over an 18-month period.
finding: The study found zero cases of congenital hypothyroidism among 625 term neonates using a cord blood TSH cutoff value of >20 mU/L, concluding this cutoff can be safely used for screening.
birth_weight: Mean 2.89 kg (ranging from 2.5 kg to 3.3 kg)
